summary: POSCO Holdings filed a 6-K re-disclosing its prior response to a media report, not a special-situation transaction. The September 30, 2026 filing restates an item first released December 5, 2025, concerning a Maeil Business Newspaper report about a roughly KRW 10 trillion HMM acquisition contest tied to Kim Jae-Chul. POSCO clarifies it signed only an MOU with Cleveland-Cliffs as part of an overseas localization strategy; business structure and investment size remain undecided, with re-disclosure promised by September 29, 2027. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated.
